answer_1.quote: A typical application of code LLMs is code completion, which automatically predicts the unfinished code ... CodeRAG feeds the reranked code knowledge into code LLM for repository-level code completion.

answer_2.quote: We use prevalent metrics for evaluation: Code Match. Exact Match (EM) and Edit Similarity (ES) ... Identifier Match. We utilize EM and F1 scores to evaluate the alignment of identifiers in the generated code and the ground-truth answer.
